description: Helps you decide what to give your champion to sell internally. You give the asset you need (an executive brief, internal business case, objection responses or presentation talking points), your solution, the customer's situation and the objections you expect. You get the asset in the champion's voice with the recommendation, answers to likely questions, the decision requested, a note on the reader and sector notes. It invents no figure or quote. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of proposal_section_writer when you need an internal asset written in the champion's voice.

asset_type.description: Type of enablement asset. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "executive_brief".

budget_context.description: Budget situation and pricing. Format is text. For example, "USD 24000 per year".

champion_name.description: Champion name. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

champion_role.description: Champion role/title. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

champion_wins.description: How this makes the champion look good. Format is text. For example, "finance teams chose the documented exception process".

competitive_context.description: Competitive alternatives being considered. Format is text. For example, "renewal decision depends on a documented approval process".

key_value_points.description: Key value points to emphasize. Format is text. For example, "resolve invoice exceptions before month-end".

known_objections.description: Expected objections from stakeholders. Format is text. For example, "The reviewer asked who owns unresolved exceptions.".

target_stakeholder.description: Who the champion needs to convince. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

urgency_drivers.description: Why act now. Format is text. For example, "an audit review due next quarter".

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

your_solution.description: Your product/solution. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

name: champion_enablement_kit
title: Champion Enablement Kit
